result.brief: 提出 Mix Forcing 因果预训练范式与 MoBA 混合注意力，联合教师强制与双向训练，为交互式视频世界模型提供强因果初始化，支持长时程在线文本交互生成。
result.reason: Introduces Mix Forcing causal pre-training with MoBA attention for interactive autoregressive video world models, preserving bidirectional visual priors; directly a video world model contribution.
